instructions.manual_exchange_notice: Upload this CHATGPT_PACKAGE.json independently in a fresh chat. VideoHoarder never uploads data automatically.

quality_rubric.grounding: Every material transcript-derived conclusion cites canonical segment_ids.
quality_rubric.coverage: Process every exact VIDEO_ID and every requested feature.
quality_rubric.semantic_synthesis: Write semantic summaries that consolidate meaning, argument, method and implications; do not concatenate or lightly rewrite transcript lines.
quality_rubric.timeline: Create boundaries only when the substantive topic changes; merge adjacent fragments about the same point.
quality_rubric.claims: Extract all consequential factual, medical, safety, financial, legal, causal, quantitative and recommendation claims; grade risk and external-verification need.
quality_rubric.entities: Perform named-entity recognition, merge aliases, type entities using the controlled list, and omit generic nouns.
quality_rubric.taxonomy: Use only controlled categories and canonical non-promotional tags.
quality_rubric.editorial: Make assessments specific to this video's evidence, value, limitations and audience; never reuse boilerplate.
quality_rubric.consistency: Use the same canonical evidence across summaries, timeline, claims, intake and editorial assessment.
quality_rubric.specificity: Preserve useful names, quantities, steps and qualifications; avoid generic filler.
quality_rubric.uncertainty: Distinguish source claims, supplied support, interpretation and external-verification needs.
quality_rubric.comments: Cluster only structured supplied comment records and report total, included count and sampling limitations; popularity is not factual verification.
quality_rubric.clips: Select only self-contained clips lasting 30-180 seconds, with valid non-overlapping timestamps and a video-specific purpose.

instructions.instructions: Use only the evidence embedded in this independently processed package and obey response_schema.feature_contracts, controlled_taxonomy, and formal_json_schema. Process every exact VIDEO_ID and return one final JSON object with no prose or markdown. All features must use the same canonical sentence-level transcript segments. Do not claim that you watched or listened to a video. Produce semantic synthesis rather than extractive transcript rewrites. Build timelines from meaningful topic boundaries. Perform complete risk-aware claim extraction and proper named-entity recognition. Make editorial_assessment.v1 a video-specific ChatGPT's Take, not boilerplate. Separate: (1) what the source says, (2) what the supplied evidence supports, (3) your interpretation, and (4) what remains uncertain or requires external verification. Cite canonical transcript segment_ids for transcript-derived conclusions. Downgrade confidence for partial/low evidence. If canonical segments are absent, do not produce transcript-derived summaries, timelines, claims, transcript-derived entities, or clips; metadata/comment-derived fields must identify their source and unsupported fields must be empty/unknown with the limitation. Validate structure, semantics, provenance, duplicates, timestamps, word counts and cross-feature consistency before returning PASS, PASS_WITH_WARNINGS or FAIL.

editorial_assessment.v1.chatgpt_take: A concise, evidence-grounded interpretation—not a repetition of the summary.

practical_value.explanation: Why the material is or is not useful.

credibility_assessment.explanation: Assess presentation and supplied support without pretending to externally fact-check.

editorial_assessment.v1.interpretation_limits: What cannot be concluded from the supplied evidence.

metadata.original_title: BICEP WORKOUT - Workout at Home | Episode 5 - BICEPS | No Dumbbells
metadata.clean_title: BICEP WORKOUT - Workout at Home | Episode 5 - BICEPS | No Dumbbells
metadata.description:
This Workout At Home series is specially designed for those who want to stay fit but are too busy to go to a gym. Workout at Home is without equipment and an ideal program for beginners. Both men and women can benefit from it.

HOW WORKOUT AT HOME CAN BE A BOON ? 

--15 MINUTES ONLY - Experts confirm that 15 minutes of workout everyday is enough to stay fit provided we eat clean.
-- BODY IS EQUIPMENT - Even though you do not have fancy machines but your own body can provide you so much resistance.One can even use the home equipment.
-- PRIVACY - You can wear whatever you feel like, listen to loud music and also practice your killer dance moves :D
-- SAVES TIME -  No matter what, workout at home will save your precious time. And time is money.
-- SAVES MONEY - You do not have to regret that you had paid the gym monthly fees but have not utilized it to full extent.
 
A PIECE OF ADVICE:

- Take out just 15 minutes from your busy schedule and dedicate it to your body. It deserves to be fit.
- Turn on your favorite music if you need a little push and start working out.
- Keep a water bottle and a hand towel along. 
- Keep sipping water in between the sets. It's important
- Give your best by maintaining a strong  muscle mind connection. Focus is the key.

FITNESS is anyway achieved in the kitchen, so make sure you EAT CLEAN.
 
Some of my previous videos which might be helpful to you in this context:

- What you should be eating? 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6whI1dKlJn4

- How can you fight junk food cravings?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8hFr16_3cuI&t=1s

- Some workout mistakes that you should avoid and why?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BbWmzx8JpAY

- How much and how you should be drinking water?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFjyrjw5HPc&t=16s

- You would require protein and these 3 egg white hacks will help.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MFzok4V-mqQ&t=1s
 
- Do not fall for these 5 Diet Myths.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GWQu3k9ls3g&t=14s

- Are you short of motivation? Watch these two videos.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lh5dsxZ0scc&t=1s
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KAZqPIvQT2c


BICEPS WORKOUT AT HOME (30 sec rest after each exercise)

1. Back Hand Push ups - 3 set * 10 reps
2. Towel Curl - 3 sets * 10 reps
3. If you find a pull up bar - 3 sets * Failure
4.  Use Home Equipment - 3 sets * 10 reps
5. Using Cylinder (complelely optional) 

You may not follow the same routine always. You can tweak the order and number of sets etc of the above exercises.

If you find this video helpful, do:

LIKE | SHARE | COMMENT

SUBSCRIBE so that you do not miss the next episodes in this series. Just click the link below:
 https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYC6Vcczj8v-Y5OgpEJTFBw

Thanks for your time. :)

- Fit Tuber

Thanks for your videos. working out since 1 Month, noticed a small change in my biceps. I think i should try shoulder workout also for better results. It's hard to implement diet plan because I tend to workout in morning.

love you bro mera bachpan yaad aa gya. ....

can u suggest me proper supplements
Bro u forgot to mention a bucket full of water. We can use quarter/half/full bucket to imitate progressive overload. Can be used as a replacement to barbell curl. Thanks for making awesome stuff.
+Sachin Sabbarwal Great idea brother. Thanks for sharing :)
Which will give better results? If i do my biceps daily or if I do it every alternate day.
+Akash Nair Definitely, the latter. Every muscle needs time to recovery.
But very effective too. Isn't it? ;)
Hi vivek, I'm not able to do more than 2-3 pushups at one go. What should I do??
+Shivansh Srivastava Just 3 words. Eat healthy and practice.
Bagal wale chat se bache.. Wo dekho... Ji... Cylinder dho rhe vivek bhyya. Ainwe hi
I have 10kg dumbbells at home. Where can I put the to use?
+Mohd's Academy You can use them to train almost every muscle. Checkout my home workout videos for reference.

Hii Sir , I am Soham Chakraborty, age 16 , weight 48. Yesterday I came across your channel and really got motivated. Today I tried the Chest workout . I did normal hand pushups for 10 times and then my hands started paining. I then proceeded further to Hands wide pushups and did 6 times. But , then I got too tired and hands got numb. I couldn't proceed further . What should I do now ? Stop the exercise? I am not even bulky. Please help me out Sir.

+Soham Chakraborty I won't suggest you to stop. Instead, practice regularly. Slowly, you will pick up. However, make sure you are having a protein rich diet along. Checkout my grocery shopping video for more information.
I have 8kgs of dumbbells at home ...what kind of exercise I can do with that ?
+abhinav shrivastava Bro you can do almost anything :) Biceps curl with single hand, double hand, concentration, hammer etc. You name it. Try varying the reps and routine for better results.
Fit Tuber my height is 5'11" and weight only 64, I have been trying to gain muscle and weight but I am not getting any result. help :)
I would like to know how to breathe during a bicep curl, double handed triceps lift also.

Vivek Sir,I loved the idea of using a bag full of books as dumbells .I did a few reps with my bag full of books and I really felt the difference in my biceps.Thank you so much for such great ideas ,Vivek Sir.Love you so much.
